sentences.fa: كمكي از دست من برمي آد؟
sentences.en: Can I do anything to help?
What would you like me to do?

sentences.fa: تو اين شرايط مي خواهي من چيكار كنم؟
sentences.en: What would you like me to do in this condition?

sentences.fa: آمبولانس خبر كنم؟ شما كمك لازم دارين.
sentences.en: Shall I call an ambulance? You need a first aide.
Shall I call the police?
You have been threatened to death.

sentences.fa: همسايه هاروخبر كنم؟ فكر كنم دزد اومده.
sentences.en: Shall I call the neighbors? I think there has been a robbery.
Shall I call your wife?
No, that's ok.
Everything will be all right.
There is nothing wrong with me.

sentences.fa: فكر مي كنم خوب مي شم.
sentences.en: I think I will be all right.
Do you think you will be all right?

sentences.fa: از كجا مي دوني خوب مي شي؟
sentences.en: How do you think you will be all right?

sentences.fa: چند دقيقه بگذره خوب مي شم.
sentences.en: I will be all right after passing a few minutes.

sentences.fa: خوب مي شي يا زنگ بزنم آمبولانس؟
sentences.en: You will be all right or I call an ambulance?
Are you all right? There is a scar on your face.

sentences.fa: فكر كنم صورتت بخيه لازم داره.
sentences.en: I think your face needs stitching.

sentences.fa: من فكر كنم مجبورم دستتون رو بخيه كنم.
sentences.en: I think I need to stitch your arm.
Let me help you up.
Let me help you lie.
Let me help you in.

sentences.fa: واقعاً لطف مي كني كه كمكم مي كني.
sentences.en: It's really kind of you to help me.
Don't mention it; I haven't done any special job.
She is as fit as a fiddle.
Is there anything wrong with your leg?

sentences.fa: نه يه موتورسوار زد بهم و فرار كرد رفت.
sentences.en: I was knocked down by someone on a motorcycle and ran away.

proverb.en: You have bitten off more than you can chew.
